subject: Use CLZ in _dictNextExp to get the next power of two (#12815)
reason: The change replaces the shift loop in the static helper _dictNextExp (src/dict.c) with a __builtin_clzl computation. The new expression 8*sizeof(long) - clzl(size-1) equals the old loop's result (the smallest e >= 2 with 2^e >= size) for every input: sizes 0-4 hit the new DICT_HT_INITIAL_EXP early-return just as the loop's e=2 start did, the unchanged size >= LONG_MAX guard still returns 63 and also keeps size-1 nonzero so clzl is never called on 0, and for all sizes in between the formula is exactly ceil(log2(size)), including at exact powers of two. It is a performance-only refactor with pro
